test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains an error.**

Naira promise me / to show me how to / fish for salmon, / but he never had the time.

options.text: but he never had the time.

solution:
The correct answer is **"Option 1: Naira promise me".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The verb "**promise**" should be in past tense "**promised**" to match the context of the sentence, which refers to a past event.
 
• The subject "Naira" and the verb "promise" are not in agreement in the present tense.
 
• Hence, "Naira promised me" is the correct phrase; it indicates that Naira made a promise to the speaker in the past.

Therefore, the corrected sentence:* "**Naira promised me **to show me how to fish for salmon, but he never had the time."*
